android.desc:
UriScan AI helps you stay hydrated by analyzing your urine color to estimate your hydration level — no lab required.

Simply scan your urine color using your phone camera, and UriScan AI instantly rates your hydration on a scale with actionable feedback. Track your results over time, log your daily water intake, and build healthier hydration habits.

KEY FEATURES

• Urine Color Scan — Instant hydration assessment using color analysis
• Hydration Score — Clear rating so you always know where you stand
• Daily Water Intake Tracker — Log glasses and monitor your progress
• Scan History — Review past results and spot trends over time
• Detailed Health Reports — In-depth analysis of your hydration patterns (Pro)
• Reminders — Set daily nudges to drink more water
• Dark Mode — Easy on the eyes, day or night

GO PRO
Unlock full history, detailed reports, and advanced insights with a single one-time purchase. No subscription. No hidden fees.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your health data stays on your device. We never sell or share your personal information.

---
UriScan AI is for general wellness purposes only and is not a medical device. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, or replace professional medical advice.
